literature_admet.ugt1a1_involvement: yes; UGT1A1 is primary enzyme for SN-38 glucuronidation
literature_admet.bbb_permeability: low; high plasma protein binding limits CNS penetration
literature_admet.hepatotoxicity_risk: moderate; biliary excretion of glucuronide can cause cholestasis
literature_admet.diarrhea_mechanism: enterohepatic recirculation of SN-38 glucuronide; bacterial β-glucuronidase cleaves conjugate in colon
literature_admet.clearance_pathway: hepatic glucuronidation followed by biliary excretion
literature_admet.key_toxicity_note: UGT1A1*28 polymorphism increases glucuronide accumulation and toxicity risk; dose reduction recommended for homozygous carriers
